info.title: Meta Service
info.description: Wraps the Meta (Facebook) Graph API v22.0 for ad account management, performance reporting, and organic posting.

AdCopy.description: Text only. No image is supplied and none is generated: Meta renders the destination page's own link preview.

customEventType.description: Required when goal is OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, COMPLETE_REGISTRATION.

OptimizationGoal.description: What the ad set optimises delivery for. Per campaign, and changeable afterwards: the right event moves one step deeper down the funnel as volume accrues.

AccountType.description: Who runs the account: `pro_human` = Pro (human), `personal_human` = Personal (human), `pro_ai` = Pro (AI)

created.description: false when this Threads account was already connected to the brand: it was refreshed, not duplicated

accountTypeLabel.description: Human label of accountType, e.g. Pro (AI)

healthReason.description: Plain-language reason when health is needs_reconnect

postId.description: Threads media id of the published post

publicationId.description: This service's record of the publication (the outcome's subject)

kind.description: `post` = a main post (one `threads_post_published` outcome); `reply` = a reply under a post (part of its thread, no outcome)

threadRootPostId.description: Threads id of the main post of this thread (itself for a post)

replayed.description: true when the idempotency key had already published this: nothing was published again

declared.description: false = runs-service refused or was unreachable; retried by the next call with the same idempotency key

outcome.description: The outcome (`threads_post_published`) declared on the caller's run (x-run-id), main posts only; null for a reply

text.description: The words to publish, 1 to 500 characters (Threads' limit). Text only: no image, no video. Published as written, except that every link to the brand's own site gets a `dy_post` tracking parameter (the answer's record keeps both: `text` as asked, `publishedText` as Threads received it).

replyToPostId.description: Omitted = a MAIN post (one Unit of `threads_post_published`). Given = a reply published under this Threads post id (the `postId` a previous call returned, to chain a thread): part of that thread, no outcome of its own.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller's own key for THIS publication, unique per org, at most 512 characters (e.g. `<run id>:<step>`). Optional, and strongly advised: without it a retry publishes the post a second time. The same key again answers the publication it already made (200, `replayed: true`) and never calls Threads twice. The same key with another account, text or parent post is a 409 `idempotency_key_reused`; while the first call is still running it is a 409 `publish_in_progress`. A publish Threads refused frees the key.

outcomeKey.description: The outcome a MAIN post declares on the caller's run (x-run-id). Only one value exists, `threads_post_published`, and it is also what an omitted `outcomeKey` means: leave it out. Any other value is a 400. Ignored for a reply (a reply declares no outcome).

kind.description: `post` = a main post (one `threads_post_published` outcome); `reply` = a reply under a post (part of its thread, no outcome)

publishedText.description: What Threads received: text with the post's dy_post on every link to the brand's own site

linkTracking.description: tracked:<links> | no_own_link | brand_unreadable | too_long | root_unknown (null before 2026-10-29, and on an imported post)

origin.description: published = this service published it; imported = read off the connected account (published outside us, hand posts included)

performedBy.description: Who performed it: ours, or the client's own team (an imported post)

outcomeKey.description: The outcome this main post declares: threads_post_published (every main post, published or imported)

mediaType.description: Threads media_type of an imported post (TEXT_POST, IMAGE, VIDEO, CAROUSEL_ALBUM, AUDIO); null on a post we published (text)

units.description: Newest first. Empty when none exists.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null = last page.

unitId.description: Stable id of this Unit at this Provider (our publication id)

subject.description: The subject this Unit carries on runs-service's ledger, exactly as declared

at.description: When the post went live on Threads (ISO 8601 UTC)

origin.description: `published` = we published it; `imported` = read off the connected account (published outside this service)

performedBy.description: `ours` = our system wrote and published it; `client_team` = someone on the client's team posted it by hand

runId.description: The run that published the post (or the import run that found it)

outcomeRunId.description: The run the outcome is declared on: `runId` for a post we published, its own dated unit run for an imported post

userId.description: The user the publishing (or connecting) call was made for

madeBy.description: Who made this Unit, and on which run

declaredOnLedger.description: True when runs-service's ledger holds this Unit. False = the post is live but its declaration has not landed yet (it is retried)

declaredAt.description: When the declaration landed (ISO 8601 UTC). Null while `declaredOnLedger` is false

brandId.description: The brand of the Threads account that carries the post

campaignId.description: The Campaign the post was published for. Null outside any Campaign (every imported post)

accountId.description: Our Threads account row that published or imported it

accountUsername.description: That account's Threads username when the post was recorded

threadsUserId.description: Threads' own id of the user who owns the post

permalink.description: Public link to the post on Threads. Null when Threads returned none

text.description: The post's words as Threads holds them

mediaType.description: Threads media type of an imported post (TEXT_POST, IMAGE, VIDEO, CAROUSEL_ALBUM, AUDIO). Null on a post we published (always text)

details.description: Per-field reasons for an invalid query

ownReplies.description: Replies under this post that are OUR publications on record (same Threads user, any depth of the thread). Threads' `replies` insight counts them: replies by others = metrics.replies - ownReplies. 0 is a real 0.

outcomeDeclaredAt.description: When the post's outcome (`outcomeKey`) landed on runs-service

outcomeRunId.description: The run that outcome is declared on: runId for a post we published, the post's own unit run (child of runId) for an imported one

accountId.description: The connected account the read ran on: the one that published it, or a later connection of the same Threads user

ownReplies.description: Replies under this post that are OUR publications on record (same Threads user, any depth of the thread). Threads' `replies` insight counts them: replies by others = metrics.replies - ownReplies. 0 is a real 0.

get.description:
This service is the Provider of the outcome `threads_post_published`. A Unit = ONE Threads MAIN post that is live: published by us (`madeBy.origin` `published`) or imported from a connected account, hand posts by the client's team included (`imported`). A reply under a post is part of its thread and is not a Unit; a publish still in flight is not one yet.

**Example.** What has this brand posted on Threads this week? `GET /orgs/units/threads-post-published?brandId=<brand>&since=2026-11-17T00:00:00Z`: `units[0].at` is the latest post, an empty `units` means none. Only what we published for one Campaign: `?campaignId=<campaign>&origin=published`.

**Who.** Every filter is optional and they combine (AND): `brandId`, `campaignId`, `accountId`, `threadsUserId`, `origin`, or exact Units by `publicationIds` / `postIds`. No filter = every Unit of the org.

**When.** `since` is yours to choose; omitted = since inception, so old Units are included. `until` is optional.

**Scope.** The CALLING org only (`x-org-id`). Never another org's data.

**Answer.** Newest first, paged by `cursor` (read until `nextCursor` is null). No Unit = 200 with an empty `units`, never a 404.

**Cost.** None: it reads this service's own records, never calls Threads, publishes nothing, changes nothing.
